items.h: Tether Froze $42.4 Million Three Months Before A Seizure Warrant, Lawsuit Says
items.s: Two Thai businessmen are suing Tether in Manhattan federal court over 42,417,785.62 USDT blacklisted across 10 Ethereum addresses. Onchain records show all 10 were frozen in a single two-and-a-half-minute batch on Oct. 30, 2025, and the seizure warrant the complaint cites is dated Feb. 19, 2026.
